facts.fact: An expert of Algeria's High Commission for Digitalisation said on Radio Algerienne that the national digital services portal offers 91 public services, with over 900,000 digital documents issued.
The same expert said citizens reach varied services with a single account on the national portal, covering the interior and local government, employment and social security, tax and justice sectors.
The expert gave portal use as about two million registered citizens, nearly 11 million visits and over 900,000 digital documents issued.
